description: Use this ONLY if your environment TIMED OUT an earlier analyze_video or resolve_video call -- the work carries on regardless and the result is still here. As a background task your environment notifies you with the result on its own, and to watch a call in flight you poll its statusUrl, so neither of those needs this tool. Pass the same video URLs or file paths you passed then, several at once if you like; a finished one returns exactly the result you would have received, one still running returns the stages it has reached. Treat "unknown" as no answer, not a failure, and read the files at your destinationPath.

videos.description: The same video URLs or file paths you passed to analyze_video or resolve_video.
